_comment: DEMO only — synthetic item listings for a fresh deployment, so the Listings screen is not empty. Every text is invented and contains DEMO; no photos, no contacts. Seeded by birge migrate as already approved and active, only into the DEMO districts of reference.json and only when sharing.listings is empty; never overwrites. The author is a fixed DEMO id with no member behind it. A real deployment starts with an empty feed.
